units.rawText: A person's taste in alcohol can reflect their personality.
units.displayText: A person's taste in alcohol can reflect their personality.

spans.text: A person's taste in alcohol can reflect their personality.

units.rawText: Take me as an example. I favor gin over any other type of alcohol. It is not the finest spirit, far from it. As a matter of fact, most bars tend to use it merely as a basic ingredient in cocktails.

units.rawText: So why am I so fond of it? You'll have a better idea why once you're more familiar with cocktails.
